provenance.asset_description: Art: Bo-Shek, artist Lucas Fernando: Bo-Shek, shobhad leader of the Beasts of Bo raiders stands ready to fight. He’s incredibly muscular and intimidating, with a spiked eyepatch and plenty of scars. He wields a painglaive in his lower arms, a massive grenade launcher in his upper arms, and is laughing maniacally, looking supremely happy to be blowing things up.
